name: @celestia/argus
description: Argus — the switchable logging port (docs/NAMING.md). createLogger(scope) + a swappable LogSink behind it (ConsoleSink default · NullSink · MultiSink). configureLogging({level,sink}) flips verbosity or routes to an analytics/tracker sink at runtime with ZERO call-site changes (G7). Zero-dependency + framework-agnostic: server (NestJS/Colyseus) and client (Jupiter) both use it.
